g.text: First-order base-e BOD exertion, constant k and ultimate carbonaceous oxygen demand. Exerted plus remaining equals20 mg/L at every time. This is an oxygen-
demand accounting curve, not dissolved oxygen in a sealed bottle or a flowing river. Nitrification and temperature variation are omitted.
